flow.name: assess_app-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: assess_app
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for assessing a MuleSoft application's Java 17 upgrade readiness

mcp:tool-listener.name: assess_app
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: assess_app
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Assess a deployed MuleSoft application for Java 17 / Mule 4.9.x upgrade readiness. Returns the current runtime version, recommended change plan, and any warnings that require human review before submitting an upgrade job. Call this before start_upgrade.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Request Received
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'REQUEST RECEIVED | flow=' ++ vars.flowName ++ ' | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | externalTranId=' ++ vars.externalTranId ++ ' | method=' ++ attributes.method ++ ' | path=' ++ attributes.requestPath]

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Response Sent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RESPONSE SENT | flow=' ++ vars.flowName ++ ' | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | status=' ++ vars.httpStatus default 200]

flow.name: start_upgrade-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: start_upgrade
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for submitting an approved Java 17 upgrade job

mcp:tool-listener.name: start_upgrade
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: start_upgrade
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Start an asynchronous Java 17 upgrade job for a MuleSoft application after the user has reviewed and approved the change plan from assess_app. Returns a jobId that can be polled with get_job_status to track progress (PROCESSING → COMMITTED → PR_OPEN → DEPLOYED).

flow.name: get_job_status-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: get_job_status
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for retrieving the current status of an upgrade job

mcp:tool-listener.name: get_job_status
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: get_job_status
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Retrieve the current status of a platform migration job submitted by start_upgrade. Poll this tool until status reaches a terminal state: DEPLOYED (success), FAILED (error — inspect the error field), or COMMITTED (changes on branch, awaiting PR merge). When status is PR_OPEN the prUrl field contains the GitHub pull request link.
